remarks: Welcome to 171 Raymond Street - a beautifully updated 3-bedroom home offering the perfect blend of comfort, style, and convenience. The main level features an open floor plan designed for modern living, seamlessly connecting the beautifully renovated kitchen, family room, and dining area. The kitchen is thoughtfully updated with quality finishes and flows effortlessly into the main living spaces, creating an inviting atmosphere for both everyday living and entertaining. The spacious primary suite provides a peaceful retreat, complemented by two additional well-appointed bedrooms. A fully finished and permitted lower level adds valuable living space - ideal for a media room, playroom, home office, or gym. Step outside to enjoy the expansive outdoor area, complete with a generous dining patio perfect for entertaining, relaxing, and enjoying warm evenings with family and friends. Conveniently located just minutes from Rowayton Village, downtown Darien, and a variety of shopping and dining options, this home offers exceptional lifestyle appeal in a prime location.
